closeout_classification: Positive DeepStream integration, but candidate not accepted because the strict ONNX-to-post-NvDCF crosscheck failed.

decode_and_native_parser_unit_tests.native_parser_scope: Person slot, geometry, deterministic order, top-k, no NMS, dimensions, and class mapping.

tensorrt_engine_build.precision: FP32 strongly typed; --noTF32; no FP16 flag

deepstream_positive_integration.performance_scope: One 710-frame 1920x1080 clip at batch 1 only; no realtime, multi-stream capacity, or accuracy extrapolation.

serialized_tensorrt_frame_141_analysis.scope: Exact saved HF input tensor through the serialized TensorRT engine for frame 141 only; not an observation of tensors inside DeepStream.

raw_tensor_parity_inside_deepstream.reason: output-tensor-meta=1 was enabled, but the unmodified object-metadata extractor did not capture raw pre-tracker nvinfer tensors.

labeled_accuracy_and_quality_baseline_se.reason: No ground-truth labels; precision, recall, ID-switch rate, exact crowd counts, and quality-baseline selection were not measured.

established: The serialized TensorRT engine passed raw and person-decode parity against HF/ONNX on the exact saved frame-141 input under the existing tolerances.
Native parser tests passed, and the full DeepStream run produced valid person boxes and persistent NvDCF IDs with clean EOS.
The strict ONNX-to-post-NvDCF crosscheck failed on both examined frames and remains unresolved.
not_established: No gross serialized-engine numeric divergence was observed on frame 141, but DeepStream preprocessing, actual input geometry, coordinate transformation, and post-NvDCF effects were not isolated like-for-like.
Lower post-tracker counts can plausibly reflect NvDCF target management, but the available evidence does not attribute all score and box mismatches to tracking.
mismatch_characterization.conclusion: Do not claim full ONNX-to-DeepStream parity. The frame-141 TensorRT result narrows the investigation but does not clear the DeepStream mismatch.

license_caveat: HF metadata declares Apache-2.0, but the pinned HF revision has no LICENSE file. The separately pinned upstream RT-DETR LICENSE and this distinction are preserved.
remaining_work: In a future diagnostic run, capture raw pre-tracker nvinfer tensors and the exact DeepStream input geometry/preprocessing for a like-for-like comparison before NvDCF.
Obtain labeled data before any detection/tracking accuracy evaluation or quality-baseline selection.
closeout_write_scope: RT-DETR closeout reports plus the explicitly requested provenance status correction; no model/configuration change, new inference, or validator rerun.
